book.name: Filemona
book.title: Filemona Filemona veize Pauloꞌa Mirihiroteꞌe Soꞌaḡa

content: Eḡe, Pauloꞌe Keriso Iesu uꞌano ḡuꞌa neḡano radiuꞌohe. Emeḡe zamarone vazeḡa zu gau tiba vazeḡa, Filemona veize emeḡe nego Timoteo teite soꞌa ꞌahi miriheꞌohe.
Ebu emeḡe eze Apia, zu emeḡe teite uti vazeḡa teige gaueꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa Arekipo, zu ḡae neo nuꞌoruꞌeteꞌe ekalesia azaḡa mazao soꞌa ꞌahi miriheꞌohe.
Badiꞌa emeḡe Mama zu Zuhiꞌa Boro Iesu Kerisoꞌa zae mazao manoḡa zu zama roḡeḡa ziniꞌenoꞌi.
Filemonaꞌa Vaze Zamare Borofeꞌohe zu Iesu mazao Fieꞌohe
E eḡe kuru zamaḡano ḡa zamareꞌetene, eḡe Badiꞌa mazao iḡaiḡa manoḡa tauḡi raꞌohe.
Mazaḡa e ḡaꞌa Badiꞌa mone azaḡa niduꞌa zamare borofeꞌeteꞌe zu Zuhiꞌa Boro Iesu mazao fieꞌeteꞌe moneo igiꞌohe.
Eme Keriso mazao fieꞌeteꞌe azaḡa radu ḡaꞌe eme teite zaꞌuzaꞌutiteꞌohe. Eꞌe uꞌano, emeꞌa Keriso teite tiburanadu aniꞌa rifiꞌeteꞌe manohugaḡa niduꞌa moneo ḡaꞌa ufeta ederoga veize e kurauꞌohe.
Eḡe nego, ḡaeꞌa Badiꞌa mone azaḡa inaraziro zu matuꞌoziniro. Ḡaeꞌa ꞌouge ze zamare borofeꞌeteꞌe uꞌano, e matuꞌe rudaro zu inariro.
Onesimo veize Umidiro
Eꞌanoꞌo eꞌe Keriso niḡano ḡaeꞌa haḡaiteꞌe haḡaiḡa haḡaoꞌi rae riḡa tuḡutuḡuꞌogaꞌe idaḡa.
Rehano eḡeꞌa ḡa zamare borofeꞌeteꞌe uꞌano, ḡae mazao umideꞌohe. Eḡe, Pauloꞌe vaze vouḡa zu izidi Keriso Iesu uꞌano ḡuꞌa neḡano radiuꞌohe.
E ḡuꞌa neḡano radiuꞌeteꞌe zamaḡano, Keriso hari manoḡa Onesimo mazao haramadu ani eꞌe mae ḡihiniro ebu eḡe ubude reiro. Izidi e ani veize ḡae mazao umideꞌohe.
Ibite aniꞌe ḡae mazao mene manoḡa reiro, rehano izidi aniꞌe emenane mazao manoḡa raꞌohe.
E ani tuḡune ameꞌohe, rehano e ani zamareꞌohe.
E hari manoḡa haramiro ꞌahine ḡuꞌa neḡano radiuꞌeteꞌea, aniꞌa eḡe teite radiuꞌenaꞌa, e danahoga uratiro. Mazaḡa aniꞌa eḡe danaheꞌetaꞌaꞌe ḡaꞌa eḡe danaheꞌeteꞌe teigiꞌuma.

Rehano ḡae ḡoere ꞌizema idanogano ane moneo e ḡau ꞌahoga haḡaoga mene uratiro. Mazaḡa Onesimoꞌa danahifine eḡeꞌa tuḡutuḡuꞌadu ḡaꞌa idaḡa rae rouga e mene urateꞌohe, rehano ḡa ḡaeꞌa bare uratadu idaḡa rae rouga urateꞌohe.
Aniꞌe ḡa modadu mada tahiḡa fararotaꞌaꞌe vesuꞌu aniꞌa ḡae vaḡe bare amadu iḡaiḡa ḡae teite radoga veize gaogi.

Aniꞌe izidi ḡae mene tuḡure vazeḡa daꞌo, rehano tuḡure vazeḡa ufeta vitine manoḡa vazeḡa, ḡae zamarone negoḡo radu ḡae teite radiꞌuma. E ani zamare borofeꞌohe, rehano ḡaꞌa e ufeta vitihe ani zamare borofiꞌuma, mazaḡa aniꞌe ḡae tuḡure vazeḡa zu negoḡo ꞌahoga, Zuhiꞌa Boro mazao fieꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa raꞌohe.
Eꞌanoꞌo ḡa eꞌe ḡae teite gaueꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa rae zamaroꞌidene, e mae ḡihiheꞌeteꞌe teige, ani zuni mae ḡihinoꞌi.
Aniꞌa ḡae mazao veꞌoḡa ꞌahoga haḡairo ga ḡauḡo nu meiro roꞌidene, ani aduga eḡe enoꞌi.
Eḡe, Pauloꞌa ꞌevorehe hina soꞌa ꞌadi miriheꞌohe. Eḡeꞌa ani veize baronoḡaniꞌuma. Ibite eꞌa hari manoḡa ḡae mazao haramadu ḡa ḡabone iziga hidiroteꞌe moneoꞌe eḡe mazao baronoꞌi rae mene ḡaꞌohe.
Eḡe nego, emeꞌe Zuhiꞌa Boro mazao fieꞌeteꞌe azaḡa radu e eḡeꞌa umideꞌeteꞌe ḡauḡa ḡaꞌa mae ḡihinoga urateꞌohe. Keriso teite tiburaroteꞌe zamaḡano, eḡe zama inaranoꞌi zu matuꞌohanoꞌi.
Eḡe umidone ḡaeꞌa mae ḡihiniꞌuma rae zamare huneꞌenaꞌa, e ḡae mazao miriheꞌohe. E edeḡa, ḡaꞌa e umidone ufeta vitine borofe ani mazao faine haḡaiꞌuma.
Ebu ḡau ꞌahoga bare umideꞌohe: Eḡe veize neḡohe ꞌahoga ruhibe toꞌi, mazaḡa Badiꞌaꞌa zae kuru egadu e zae vaḡe bare tuḡuhoga urateꞌohe.
Uhiu Ḡoeꞌa Ḡonaga
Keriso Iesu uꞌano, eḡe teite ḡuꞌa neḡano radiuꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa, Epafaraꞌa ḡae mazao uhiu ḡoeꞌa tuḡureꞌohe.
Ebu eḡe teite tiburu gaueꞌeteꞌe azaḡa, Mareko, Arisitako, Dema ebu Luka zuni uhiu ḡoeꞌa tuḡureꞌohe.
Zuhiꞌa Boro Iesu Kerisoꞌa zae mazao manoḡa ziniꞌenoꞌi.
